newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Proventus bids for 20 pct of Orrefors.
newsitem.headline: Proventus bids for 20 pct of Orrefors.

text.p: Swedish holding company Proventus AB said on Friday it bid 145 crowns per share to shareholders in glass maker Orrefors Kosta Boda for shares corresponding to 20 percent of the capital in the company.

"The board of Proventus AB has decided to make a public partial offer to shareholders in Orrefors Kosta Boda AB (for shares) corresponding to 20.0 percent of the total number of shares and votes in the company," Proventus said in a statement.
Earlier on Friday, Proventus said it had acquired 180,686 shares in Orrefors Kosta Boda, bringing its total holding in the luxury goods maker to 760,875 shares or 21.1 percent of the company.
Proventus, which is unlisted, said it had also bought an option that would allow it to take a further 9.1 percent stake in the company.

Including this option, Proventus said it was the largest owner in Orrefors, with 30.2 percent of the votes and capital in the company. Acceptance of the 20 percent share offer would give Proventus a majority holding.
It said the offer represented a premium of 26 percent over the last price paid for the Orrefors share of 115 crowns before trade in the share was suspended on the Stockholm bourse on Friday morning.
Proventus said it was "aware" of the acquisition of 20 pct of the shares in Orrefors by Denmark's Royal Copenhagen on October 9.
"The logic behind the acquisition does not exclude the possibility that Royal Copenhagen has the ambition to increase its holding to create a Danish-controlled group," it said.
Proventus said it had aimed to take control of Orrefors Kosta Boda for some time in order to "actively support the company industrially and financially in its continued development".
